ScadaWatt, ölçüm verilerini izleme, rapo: ScadaWatt brings generation, consumption, limit and reactive power data together on one platform. With OSOS meter data, hourly net-metering tracking and market clearing prices (PTF), you see both the technical and commercial side of your energy.

Yenilenebilir enerji üretiminde ölçüm, p: Solar power plants need accurate generation measurement, performance monitoring and the ability to act on site when necessary. ScadaWatt meets all three on one platform.

Kompanzasyon Takibi ve Kontrolü: Power Factor Correction Monitoring and Control
Reaktif güç sürekli izlenir; limit aşıml: Reactive power is continuously monitored, with correction controlled automatically when limits are exceeded.
Reaktif güç değerleri sürekli izlenir. L: Reactive power is monitored continuously. When limits are exceeded, ScadaWatt controls the power factor correction system to reduce the risk of reactive penalties.
Saatlik veriler üzerinden fatura doğrula: Bills are checked against hourly data, making billing errors easy to spot.
Tüketim kadar üretim: şebeke yönüne ener: Generate what you consume, without exporting power to the grid.
Zero Injection modülü ile eviriciler din: The Zero Injection module measures the facility's real-time consumption and continuously adjusts inverter output to match it, so generation never exceeds consumption.
Böylece şebeke yönüne enerji gitmemesi s: This prevents power from being exported to the grid. The process is monitored and managed through ScadaWatt screens and reports.
Yük atma süreçlerini otonom hale getirin: Apply scheduled load-shedding instructions to the site automatically.
Planlı üretim durdurma modülü ile yük at: Scheduled load-shedding instructions are defined in ScadaWatt and applied to the site automatically at the set time, with no need to send a team on site.
PRO pakette acil durdurma eylemi ve saha: PRO also includes emergency shutdown and remote opening and closing of the switchgear cell.
Alarm, limit aşımı ve gün sonu üretim bi: Alarms, limit exceedances and daily generation updates via SMS, email, iOS and Android.
Gün sonu üretim bilgileri, anlık alarm d: Critical events, including daily generation updates, active alarms and limit exceedances, are delivered immediately.
Bildirimler SMS, e-posta ve iOS / Androi: Notifications are available through SMS, email and the iOS / Android apps.
Ekosistemin veri toplama ve işleme merke: The ecosystem’s data acquisition and processing hub
S3000i, ekosistemimizin veri toplama ve: S3000i is the heart of the ScadaWatt ecosystem on site. It reads data from inverters, analysers, meters and sensors, processes and stores it locally, then sends it to the ScadaWatt platform. If the internet connection drops, it keeps recording.
Karmaşık ve özel ihtiyaçlar için çok ama: A versatile device for complex, specialised requirements
S4000MC, daha karmaşık ve özel ihtiyaçla: S4000MC is a versatile device designed for complex, specialised requirements. Working alongside S3000i to collect and process data, it extends the available control scenarios.
LOMR-07H, şebeke arızası durumunda rölel: LOMR-07H continuously measures grid voltage and frequency. When it detects a fault, it triggers its relay outputs so that the plant can be safely disconnected from the grid through the control panel. It connects to ScadaWatt via RS485 Modbus.

Sahaya doğru alçalıyoruz. Panel sıraları: What a plant doesn't generate matters as much as what it does. ScadaWatt monitors every device on site to answer that question.

Hizmetlerimizi Kullanırken Oluşturduğunu: Information Generated While Using Our Services
İnternete bağlanabilen her modeme İntern: Every modem capable of connecting to the internet is assigned a string of numbers known as an Internet Protocol (IP) address by your Internet Service Provider. These number strings are assigned within geographic blocks.
Bir IP adresini inceleyerek konumunuz ya: By examining an IP address, your location can only be approximately determined at the city or district level.
Ancak biz IP adresinizi yalnızca güvenli: However, we use your IP address solely for the purposes required by our security algorithms.
Örneğin; hatalı bir giriş yapıldığında s: For example, when an incorrect login occurs, we will use it to recognize you and prevent you from being logged out of the system.
Ayrıca; sisteminize hatalı bir müdahaled: Additionally, if there is an unauthorized attempt to access your system, we use the IP address to log the identity of the individual responsible and, if necessary, provide evidence to official state authorities.
Sizi tanımlayan bilgilerdir. Listeleme i: This is information that identifies you. We use it in listing processes for your system administrators and to greet you in SMS and email texts.
Bazı durumlarda size SMS veya E-Posta gö: In some situations, we may need to send you an SMS or email. Examples include alarm situations and end-of-day production reports. For this reason, you can enter or remove your phone number and email address in the system at your discretion.
Sildiğiniz telefon numaranız ve e-posta: Any phone number or email address you delete will be immediately removed from the system in a way that cannot be recovered. They will not be shared with any other institutions.
Bazen önemli bir duyuru yayınlamak zorun: Sometimes, we may need to issue an important announcement. In such cases, we may send you an SMS or email, or even call you directly via a representative to reach you as quickly as possible.
Kişisel bilgileriniz dışında üretim sant: Apart from your personal information, we also care about the security of your production plants. Therefore, for users who have significant authority that could affect plant production, we record certain information about your mobile devices. We ensure that every action is performed by the ‘same and trusted mobile device.’ Even if you lose your account credentials, you will not be granted access to your account from a different device unless you register it as a ‘trusted device.’ The information required for this security algorithm includes: i) Device Manufacturer ii) Device Model iii) Unique Identifier: This is a string of characters that can be used to uniquely identify your device. It can be used for security and fraud detection. These unique identifiers (sometimes referred to as UUIDs) may be shared with us by your device manufacturer. IMEI numbers are an example of this and are unique to each device.
ScadaWatt’a ait cihazlar, çeşitli yöntem: ScadaWatt devices collect information from the site through various methods, temporarily store it internally, and transmit it to our servers located in highly secure data centers in Turkey for permanent storage and analysis.
Sahadan alınan veriler doğrultusunda san: Based on the data collected from the site, we provide performance analyses, alarm monitoring, production-consumption comparisons, and live online monitoring for your plants.
Sahadan toplanıp saklanan veriler şunlar: The data collected and stored from the site includes: i) General Facility Information ii) General Inverter Information iii) Inverter Real-Time Production Information iv) Inverter Status and Alarm Information v) Electric Grid Voltage-Frequency Information vi) Facility's Produced-Consumed Current Information vii) Facility's Frequency Synchronization Information viii) Weather Data for the Facility's Location ix) Time and Personnel Information for Personnel Attendance Tracking Systems x) General Information on Production Equipment Used in the Facility (e.g., solar panels).

ScadaWatt cihazları internet üzerinden h: ScadaWatt devices cannot connect to any site over the internet, so they are not vulnerable to threats like viruses, and they do not endanger the network they are connected to.
VPN ağımız UDP ve TCP bilgi transferi pr: Our VPN uses UDP and TCP data transfer protocols, SSL for secure socket layers, TLS 1.2 for transmission layer security, and 256-bit OpenSSL for encryption and authentication certificates.
